# Browser Bridge

> Zero-port local MCP server, Native Messaging host, cross-browser extension (Edge, Chrome, Brave, Firefox), and zero-dependency Python SDK that let AI agents act safely inside your own signed-in browser tabs.

## One-Prompt AI Agent Installation

- [Agent Installation Playbook (docs/INSTALL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/docs/INSTALL.md): Step-by-step zero-build SHA-256-verified installer instructions for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Codex.
